citation: Purinton, B., & Bookhagen, B. (2019). Introducing PebbleCounts: a grain-sizing tool for photo surveys of dynamic gravel-bed rivers. Earth Surface Dynamics, 7, 859-877. https://doi.org/10.5194/esurf-7-859-2019
